parameters.query: SELECT order_id, stage, stage_entered_at, threshold_hours, elapsed_hours, alert_key FROM `{{ $env.GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT }}.{{ $env.BIGQUERY_DATASET }}.v_delayed_orders`

parameters.jsCode: return items.map((item) => ({ json: { ...item.json, notification_status: 'simulated', status: 'open', notification_attempts: 1, last_seen_at: new Date().toISOString() } }));

parameters.query: MERGE `{{ $env.GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT }}.{{ $env.BIGQUERY_DATASET }}.alerts` T USING (SELECT alert_key, order_id, stage, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS detected_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS last_seen_at FROM `{{ $env.GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT }}.{{ $env.BIGQUERY_DATASET }}.v_delayed_orders`) S ON T.alert_key = S.alert_key AND T.status = 'open' WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET last_seen_at = S.last_seen_at WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (alert_key, order_id, stage, condition_type, detected_at, last_seen_at, status, notification_status, notification_attempts, last_error, resolved_at) VALUES (S.alert_key, S.order_id, S.stage, 'stage_delay', S.detected_at, S.last_seen_at, 'open', 'simulated', 0, NULL, NULL);
